title: Heavenly Respect and Heavenly Love Conquer All
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Dastoor yaa Sayyidi. Laa ilaaha illa-Llah, Laa ilaaha illa-Llah, La ilaaha illa-Llah
Muhammadun Rasoolullah, `alayhi salaatullah wa salaamuh wa `ala jamee`i 'l -anbiya wa 'l-awliya wa man
tabi`bhum ila yawmi 'd-deen yaa Rabbana yaa Rabb ighfir wa 'rham wa anta khayru 'r-Rahimeen, yaa Allah.
alhimna rushdana wa a`idhna min shuroori anfusina yaa Rabb. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Thumma 's-salaam `ala Saahib az-Zamaan khalifati rasoolillah (s) wa `ala jamee`a ashaabu 'n-nawba wa
rijaalillah `alayhim as-salaam.
Narjoo, we are asking their heavenly support. And we are saying A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem.
We are running away from Shaytan and shaytanic works that are making ma`moor kharaab, corrupting
everything, to follow Shaytan. That is the biggest trouble and the biggest problem for nations, for dunya and
everything on it or under it. Therefore, we are asking, "O our Lord, protect Your servants from Shaytan and
its tricks and traps. Astaghfirullah! We are asking forgiveness," that I am saying, “O our Lord, protect
ourselves.”
As a heavenly protocol, we must address first Allah Almighty, then we may ask one ant. Even one ant, or less
than an ant, that it is created by the Creator, Allah Almighty, is enough to take away Shaytan and its

followers. But as a heavenly protocol and heavenly good tidings, and through Islam's good manners, we are
first addressing to His most Glorified Presence, by saying, “O our Lord.” Then we may ask; it is easy. We are
saying, A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem, and Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem also. (Mawlana
Shaykh stands) That is our honor, to be able to say, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.
O our Attenders! YOU MUST BELIEVE AND YOU MUST PRACTICE FOR EVERYTHING TO SAY Bismillahi
'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem! If not, you are going to be destroyed from this planet to another unknown territory!
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) The main protector is for Mankind to say Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. Don't
take it as a joke, No! We are speaking on reality. You must say (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Bismillahi 'rRahmani 'r-Raheem, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. (Mawlana Shaykh sits) For beginning and ending,
every time you must say Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.
O our Attenders! As-salaamu `alaykum. Be serious ones for such heavenly announcements. Yes. Don't think
that that one is sitting and speaking. No. It is a heavenly addressing to all members of Humanity! They must
listen! They must obey! But you are free, believing or not believing. If you are believing, a benefit will come to
you. If you are not believing, troubles will be raining on you. You may be the First Lady (chuckles), or the
Russian Emperor, or going to be Vizier, or going to be Her Majesty Queen, or His Majesty King of the UN, or
the Indian Emperor. You may be. But you are under a heavenly power that is turning your head.
Don't say, "We are Salafi `ulamas." (chuckles) Once again to you, Salafiyoon! Leave Wahaabiyoon, they are
no-mind people. Wahabiyoon and wood is the same. They have heads but nothing is in it. They have hearts,
but nothing is in it from heavenly love and heavenly respect. Yes. That is the most important point; heavenly
respect and heavenly love. That is what our heavenly protectors, or heavenly teachers, or heavenly holy ones,
are saying. They are on these two matters; what is heavenly love and heavenly respect? We are now putting
on a strong base for today's sayings. Yes. What do you think?
O our Attenders! Look, listen, and obey! Don't object on anything. If you are going to make and objection,
come and sit here and address to people. It is an old chair and an old person. You take a new chair, to be the
Chairman of Shaytanic groups. And look for a young one to address to you. If you are not happy with such an
old person, if you are unhappy, look at a young one with a chair in a good condition. If you can find a king’s
chair also, it is okay. Sit down and address people. I am calling Salaafiyoon, you may address daily to people.

Yawmun jadeed, rizqun jadeed, “A new day, new rizq, heavenly blessings, provisions.” Daily, There is a new
heavenly feast. Come and take your share, eat and be thankful to Allah Almighty. What is it that is asked from
people? One, heavenly respect and heavenly love.
O Salafi 'ulamas! Ask from heavenly ones. Or what do you think was the summary of the messages of all the
prophets? From where were they coming? What were they asking from people? They were asking for respect
and love, heavenly respect and heavenly love. “O people,” prophets were calling to people, "come and take a
share from heavenly respect and heavenly love." Anything wrong, His Holiness Pope? Anything wrong, O
Chief Rabbi? Anything wrong, Russian’s Orthodox Church Chief Patriarch? He is respecting me and respect
is bringing love from hearts to hearts. Allahu Akbar wa lillahi 'l-hamd. Heavenly praising and heavenly love,
that is what we were saying; heavenly respect and heavenly love.
No one knows the numbers of all prophets except the Lord of Heavens, the One Who is sending.
•••••••• ••••••••••• •••••• Wa laqad arsalnaa Noohan, “I am sending Noah [Moses, Jesus Christ].”
(Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) Allah Almighty is saying, "I am sending Noah (a), Abraham (a), Moses (a),
Jesus Christ (a), Zachariah (a), Musa (a), Yunus (a), Haroon (a), Yusuf (a), Yaqoob (a), Nuh (a). From the
beginning, from Adam (a), I am sending to you." For what? The summary is that they are teaching you
heavenly respect and heavenly love; that was their main mission. All of the prophets were calling people to
heavenly respect and heavenly love. True or wrong? Say! No-mind Wahabi people also. You are doing that?
You are doing nothing and you should be punished!
Yes, that is the summary of the mission of all prophets. They are only calling people and saying to them, "O
our Attenders!" We are calling you to be respectful to Who created you." This is it. There is no other aim in
this life. Nothing is going to be valuable beside heavenly love and heavenly respect. All of them, throw it to
the WC. "Take this only! Heavenly love and heavenly respect." Laa ilaaha illa-Llah. Why are you quarreling
with me? I am nothing. But look at what is going to be said, with which mentality heavenly sources are
sending such never ending realities to you. Look at that One. Look. It is jawhar, “precious." More than
essence, the most valuable thing that you may reach through this entire world. These are the two things that
is your maqsoodun asliyy, main aim. You must ask for love and heavenly love. Change your hearts to be full
with heavenly love and prepare yourself to give most high respect to that One, that amruhu fi 's-samawaat,

“His orders in the heavens.”
O our Attenders! Take care. If you are not taking care, someone will take your ear like a foolish student, when
his teacher pulls his ear; something like that will come to you. Now, you must understand that you have been
offered with something from heavens to do, to take and to reach. What was it? As they are saying, heavenly
respect and heavenly love. Try to reach those two aspects. And all the prophets were coming to call you to
reach a heavenly love and to reach for heaven's respect. And look, who is giving to you these two aspects? You
can find it through the east or through the west, through London, through Moscow, through Japan, through
India, or through Iran. Iranian people are preparing themselves for a war, for fighting. What are you fighting
for? For what are you preparing yourselves, to kill people? To kill those that Allah Almighty created them to
be good servants and to be seekers of most valuable aspects, heavenly respect and heavenly love. O Iranian
responsible ones for 80 million people! Why are you preparing yourselves for fighting? What is the benefit to
make a fight? Bring your people to Divinely Presence full with love, heavenly love and heavenly respect? No!
LEAVE THAT! Or punishment is coming on the Head of that State also!!
I am a weak one, but aqwaa, most strong ones may grab their ears, taking them up. They are thinking
everything is under their control. No, it is not under their control. And we don’t like to make people fall in
troubles. We are asking to bring people to heavenly love and heavenly respect, then heavenly love will shower
them.
O Leaders of all states, including Turkey, Russia, Arabia, India, China, Japan, everywhere: we are warning! If
they are not taking care, in one breath their souls are going to be taken up. That is a heavenly warning for all
nations now. We are asking from our leaders to try to teach people, to learn the most high respect for
heavenly aspects and the most beautiful love, sweetest love, Love Oceans, Love Oceans. (Mawlana Shaykh
smiles)
O People! Why are you running to Enmity Oceans? Who is teaching you? Allah Almighty just taught you to be
wild ones, more than wild animals in the jungles? He ordered you to do this? I am asking the United States
President also, the Chinese, Russian, Turkish, Arab presidents, kings and sultans. I am asking. Is Allah
Almighty making you for destroying Humanity, to give trouble to them, to make them unhappy and to
destroy their physical beings for nothing? Now what is that? May Allah forgive us.

O People! Come and here and ask who can give to you heavenly love and heavenly respect, you should be
happy here and hereafter. And we are asking forgiveness from my Lord, Allah Almighty (swt) (Mawlana
Shaykh stands) and intercession from His most beloved one in His Divinely Presence, Sayyidina Muhammad
(s) (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Fatihah.
(Mawlana Shaykh makes du`a)
Mashaa-Allah, alhamdulillah. We must understand, Mashaa-Allah, be with your Lord, and you will be happy
here and Hereafter. Allahu Akbar.
Fatihah.
(Mawlana Shaykh sings.)
Dome, dome, dome, dome 8x
03.08.2010
